intro.h2: Showers and Backsplashes From a Family Tile Team
paragraphs: Wolston Tile Designs is a family owned company offering tile installation in Duncan, from custom walk-in showers to kitchen backsplashes and floors through the whole house. The company's own Facebook post says it has won the Readers' Choice Award for Tile Installation for the last three years.

Reviewers keep describing the same habits. The crew starts when they say they will and does not overbook. They keep a very neat workspace and work to keep demolition dust out of the rest of the house. And the price at the end matches the original contract. Erik and Jennifer are the names customers mention, and one calls them true artists.

services.h2: Tile Work in and Around Duncan

items.name: Custom tile showers
items.blurb: Walk-in showers fill much of their Facebook page. One photo shows large travertine-look wall tiles in an offset pattern, a long recessed niche, a floating tiled bench, grab bars and a river pebble floor. Some homeowners design their own shower and Wolston builds it.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with large travertine-look wall tile, long recessed niche, floating tiled bench, black grab bars and river pebble floor

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: Backsplashes get the same care. One kitchen has glass arabesque tile behind the cooktop, with glass subway tile wrapping the range hood and running along the walls above granite counters. One reviewer had a new backsplash put in along with new floors.

image.alt: Pale grey glass arabesque tile backsplash behind a black cooktop, glass subway tile on the range hood, cream cabinets and white and grey granite counters

items.name: Tile floors
items.blurb: Floors often run through more than one room. One customer had new tile flooring installed in the kitchen, bathrooms and hallways, and noticed how carefully the crew kept dust from getting into everything while the old tile was being torn out.

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Wolston takes on small bath remodels and full bathroom tile. They are upfront about the limits: they are not licensed plumbers, so plumbing work such as installing shower trim kits is left to a plumber once the tile is finished.

image.alt: Photo needed: finished small bathroom remodel

items.name: Shower inspections
items.blurb: When a shower floor fails, Wolston gets called out to look at it. A May 2026 Facebook post shows them inspecting a shower built in 2014 and trying to understand the original design. Ask about an inspection if your shower leaks or the floor has problems.

items.title: On time, never overbooked
items.text: One customer listed it first: they start the job at the time they tell you and never over book their ability, so you know when work will begin.

items.title: Clean, low-dust demolition
items.text: Reviewers mention a very neat workspace and real attention to keeping dust from getting into everything while the old tile comes out.

items.title: The price you signed
items.text: One customer wrote that the final pricing did not change from the original contract on day one, and called their prices very fair.

items.title: Voted by readers
items.text: Wolston Tile Designs says it has won the Readers' Choice Award for Tile Installation the last three years, thanks to customers who vote for them year after year.

about.h2: About Erik, Jennifer and Wolston Tile Designs
about.text: Wolston Tile Designs is a family owned and operated tile company based at 1927 Ridgeway Cir in Duncan, Oklahoma. Reviewers name Erik and Jennifer, and one calls them true artists whose work is perfect when they are done. The team sticks to tile: showers, backsplashes, floors and bathroom remodels, and openly leaves plumbing to licensed plumbers. Their Facebook page, followed by more than 1,100 people, shares finished showers, before and after photos and the occasional honest look at a failed shower they were asked to inspect.
about.owner_role: Named in reviews as the people doing the tile work; a reviewer refers to 'the Wolston's'; the business is described as family owned and operated; titles not published

process.h2: How a Wolston Tile Project Goes

steps.title: Call
steps.text: Call (580) 467-4399 Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and describe the shower, backsplash or floor you are planning.

steps.title: Plan the design
steps.text: Bring your own ideas or choose tile together. Some homeowners design their own custom shower and Wolston builds it to match.

steps.title: Contract and start date
steps.text: You agree on a contract, and reviewers say both the start date and the final price matched what was agreed on day one.

steps.title: Careful demolition and install
steps.text: Old tile comes out with care to keep dust contained, then the new tile goes in, with the workspace kept neat each day.

steps.title: Plumber finishes the trim
steps.text: Because they are not licensed plumbers, a plumber installs the shower trim kits after the tile work is complete.

items.name: Jamie S.
items.text: 05/25/2021. We contracted the Wolston’s for a pretty big job and wow did they meet the task head on with 100% professionalism. Here are the key take aways 1. They will start the job at the time they tell you and never over book their ability. 2. They keep a very neat workspace. 3. Their work is phenomenal, 100% flawless. 4. Their prices are very fair. Overall we honestly couldn’t be more satisfied with their business. How often do you hire contractors that are punctual, clean, neat and pricing in the end doesn’t change from the original contract on day one? You get all that when you hire Wolston Elite Tile. service_area.text: Wolston Tile Designs is based at 1927 Ridgeway Cir in Duncan, Oklahoma, and its Facebook page lists Duncan as home. Google does not publish a wider service area, so if you live outside Duncan, call (580) 467-4399 to ask whether your home is within their range before you start choosing tile. Jobs are done in your home, from a single backsplash to every floor in the house.

items.a: Wolston Tile Designs is open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on weekends, according to Google. Call (580) 467-4399 during those hours to talk about your project, or send a message through their Facebook or Instagram page.

No. In their own Facebook post they explain that they are not licensed plumbers and leave that work to plumbers. That is why their finished shower photos often show no trim kits, which a plumber installs after the tile is done. Plan for a plumber as part of a shower project.

items.q: Can I design my own shower?
items.a: Yes. A June 2026 Facebook post shows a finished custom shower that the homeowners designed themselves, which Wolston then built. If you already have tile, a layout or photos you like, bring them to the first conversation so the plan starts from your ideas.

Tearing out old tile is dusty work, but reviewers say Wolston pays close attention to keeping dust from getting into everything and keeps a very neat workspace. Ask how they will protect the rest of your home before demolition begins on your project.

items.q: Are estimates free, and are you insured?
items.a: Free estimates, insurance, warranty terms and years in business are not published on Google or Facebook, so ask when you call. Reviewers do say the final price matched the original contract and that the prices were very fair. Get your contract in writing before work starts.
